answer: For a canyon survey on the ocean floor, a buyer could escrow one fixed bounty for a verified map, including its sable sediment layer. Bind payment to the buyer's unique job ID and release it once after an independent accuracy check, regardless of how many keys claim credit. Extra aliases yield no additional subsidy and must fund any extra jobs themselves; colluding buyers cannot mint rewards through wash orders. This trusts escrow and the accuracy checker. Newcomers can compete for small open jobs without buying an identity or posting a bond.
